description_en: Invoke the CheckTransferInFeasibility API to validate whether a domain name can be transferred in
description_zh: 调用CheckTransferInFeasibility校验域名是否可以转入
name: CheckTransferInFeasibility

parameters.help_en:
The language of the error message returned by the API. Valid values:
zh: Chinese
en: English

Default value: en
parameters.help_zh:
接口返回错误信息语言。取值：
zh：中文；
en：英文。

默认为en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The user IP address. You can set it to 127.0.0.1
parameters.name: user_client_ip

parameters.help_en: The domain name to be validated
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The transfer-in password for the domain name
parameters.name: transfer_authorization_code

CanTransfer.description_en:
Indicates whether the domain name can be transferred in. Valid values:
true: The domain name can be transferred in.
false: The domain name cannot be transferred in
CanTransfer.description_zh:
是否可以转入。取值：
true：可以转入。
false：不可以转入

Code.description_en: The error code returned when the domain name cannot be transferred in
Code.description_zh: 不可转入时，返回错误代码

Message.description_en: The error description returned when the domain name cannot be transferred in
Message.description_zh: 不可转入时，返回错误描述
Message.example: This domain name is in transfer prohibited status, so it cannot be transferred. You can contact your original registrar to change its status.

ProductId.description_en: The product ID of the domain name
